# Axioma

> Website design and development studio based in Almaty, Kazakhstan. Works with clients across Kazakhstan, the CIS and worldwide.

- Services: landing pages, company websites, online stores and catalogs, websites with 3D and animation.
- Prices: agreed individually for each project after a short conversation about the task.
- Contact: Telegram https://t.me/nonexxxist or the request form at https://axioma.codes/#request
- Portfolio: https://axioma.codes/#work
